appeal.statutoryBody: ClaimSaathi generates customer-side grievance briefs grounded in the IRDAI 2024 Master Circular. Policyholders must verify dates and submit directly to the Insurer Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO). If unaddressed within 30 days, file with the Insurance Ombudsman under Rule 17 of the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.
